summary: Executed backend pytest workflow + targeted Playwright UI/integration checks for public, admin, groups/transfer, schedule, and student auth flows. Core flows mostly work; transfer between groups is consistently failing with backend 500.

critical.issue: Returns 500 due to Mongo update conflict when updating group_ids with both $pull and $addToSet in one update operation.

integration_issues.flow: Admin > Groups and transfers > student transfer

issues: No blocking visual defects observed in tested desktop viewport.

action_items: Fix transfer endpoint by splitting student group update into sequential operations or using update pipeline to avoid Mongo path conflict.
After fix, retest group transfer from admin UI and verify student schedule reflects target group lessons.
Optionally improve leads tab UX with explicit empty-state text for pending leads to reduce operator ambiguity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (>1000 lines). Split into routers/services/models for maintainability and safer iteration.
In transfer_student(), combining $pull and $addToSet on the same field (group_ids) in one update causes Mongo WriteError code 40 and should be refactored.
seed_data_creation: Created test branch, lead, student, teacher, classroom, groups, and schedule records prefixed/created during test flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_api_workflows.py as regression baseline. Current hard failure is isolated to transfer endpoint; other tested APIs pass. UI transfer reproduces backend 500. Student schedule API works when schedule is created for student's assigned group.
rca of the issue: Repro: (1) create two groups, (2) assign student to group A, (3) POST /api/admin/students/{student_id}/transfer from A to B. Result: HTTP 500. Backend log shows pymongo.errors.WriteError: 'Updating the path group_ids would create a conflict at group_ids' at server.py transfer_student() update_one on students collection. Mitigation: perform two separate update_one calls ($pull then $addToSet) or use aggregation pipeline update to mutate array atomically without path conflict.
